title: Natural Language Processing Methods to Identify Oncology Patients at High Risk for Acute Care with Clinical Notes

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the empirical cumulative distributions of predicted risk score percentiles across different racial subgroups (Black, White, Asian, Other) to check for disproportionate risk predictions.

Comparing the empirical cumulative distributions of predicted risk score percentiles across different health insurance types (Medicare, Medicaid, Private, Other) to identify risk overestimation for specific groups.

Comparing the empirical cumulative distributions of predicted risk score percentiles across different cancer stages (Stage I, II, III, IV, and Unknown) to evaluate if risk predictions are skewed by tumor stage.
